segments.name: Sensors segment
segments.description: Makes precision foil resistors and strain gages, including advanced sensors, for OEMs in industrial, medical, avionics and test applications.
segments.evidence: The Sensors segment is comprised of our precision resistor and strain gage businesses.

segments.name: Weighing Solutions segment
segments.description: Supplies load cells, transducers and weighing modules to industrial, commercial and medical equipment makers and onboard vehicle weighing customers.
segments.evidence: The Weighing Solutions segment is comprised of our VPG Transducers, VPG Onboard Weighing, BLH Nobel, Stress-Tek and Vulcan businesses.

segments.name: Measurement Systems segment
products: optical and electronic roll force measurement and control equipment
specialized dynamic thermal-mechanical test and simulation systems
high-performance signal conditioning, data acquisition and control systems
segments.description: Builds highly specialized measurement and testing systems for steel production, materials development and safety testing, sold to industrial and research customers.
segments.evidence: The Measurement Systems reporting segment is comprised of highly specialized systems for steel production, materials development, and safety testing.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily OEMs, pay for specialty precision sensors, weighing solutions and measurement systems engineered to their own specifications.
revenueModel.evidence: Our specialty products are usually designed, or engineered, to meet unique specifications for OEMs.
